shareholder applying for 400 shares, didn't pay the allotment and call
money and his allotted shares were forfeited by the company. Later, the
forfeited shares were reissued at 80 each as fully paid.

at the time of reissue of forfeited shares?

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Calls-in-Advance is shown under Current Liabilities under the head 'Other Current Liabilities' in the company Balance Sheet. [Corporate Ref #7]
Statement II: The company is liable to pay interest on Calls-in-Advance even if there are no profits earned during the financial year.

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement I is correct: Under Schedule III of Companies Act 2013, Calls in Advance is presented under Current Liabilities (Other Current Liabilities).
2. Statement II is correct: Interest on calls in advance is a debt liability payable irrespective of whether profits exist.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
